title: Proper morphisms: compact supports equal direct image
statement:
For a proper
$f:X\to Y$ and the canonical identification
$Rf_!\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_*$ of
[def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed] (the compactification
$j=\operatorname{id}$, $p=f$), the map $\operatorname{Ex}_!$
of [def-cbc-exchange-map] is the proper-base-change exchange map
of [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange]; consequently the
compact-support base change of
[thm-cbc-finite-torsion] specializes to proper base change for
proper $f$.

proof.text:
For $j=\operatorname{id}$ the extension-by-zero identification
of [def-cbc-exchange-map] is the identity, so
$\operatorname{Ex}_!$ is the exchange map of
[def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange] for the proper $p=f$, by
[def-cbc-exchange-map] and the identification
$Rf_!=Rf_*$ of [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed].

lean.statement: theorem Etale.properCoincidence_exchange (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] {X X' Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} {g' : X' ⟶ X} [IsProper f] (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) : (Functor.whiskerRight (Etale.properCoincidenceIdentityOpenPlus A f).hom (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g).mapDerivedCategoryPlus ≫ Etale.derivedBaseChangeMapPlus (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) sq.toCommSq = Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationPlusBaseChangeMap A sq (Compactification.ofIsProper f) ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g').mapDerivedCategoryPlus (Etale.properCoincidenceBaseChangedPlus A sq).hom) ∧ IsIso (Etale.derivedBaseChangeMapPlus (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) sq.toCommSq)
lean.note: Section 1(B): the recorded Nonempty isomorphism neither specifies the canonical identity-open identification nor states coincidence of Ex_! with the proper-base-change exchange. This module constructs the identity-open identification from the specified open adjunction, constructs its arbitrary-candidate and base-change transports using the recorded canonical comparison, and states equality of the two exchanges and invertibility. The pro-etale identity-open identification is constructed by the identical adjunction formula for the item normalization.
